color-primary.label: Primary
color-primary.note: Buttons, links and accents. The lighter and darker shades follow it. Pair with On primary.

color-on-primary.label: On primary
color-on-primary.note: Text and icons on a primary background. Keep enough contrast with Primary.

color-primary-lighter.label: Primary lighter
color-primary-lighter.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-primary-darker.label: Primary darker
color-primary-darker.note: Hover and active states. Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-secondary.label: Secondary
color-secondary.note: Second accent color. The lighter and darker shades follow it.

color-on-secondary.label: On secondary
color-on-secondary.note: Text and icons on a secondary background. Keep enough contrast with Secondary.

color-secondary-lighter.label: Secondary lighter
color-secondary-lighter.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-secondary-darker.label: Secondary darker
color-secondary-darker.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-ink-muted.label: Muted text
color-ink-muted.note: Hints, labels and other secondary text.

color-gray-50.label: Gray 50
color-gray-50.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-100.label: Gray 100
color-gray-100.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-200.label: Gray 200
color-gray-200.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-300.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-400.label: Gray 400
color-gray-400.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-500.label: Gray 500
color-gray-500.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-600.label: Gray 600
color-gray-600.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-700.label: Gray 700
color-gray-700.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-800.label: Gray 800
color-gray-800.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-900.label: Gray 900
color-gray-900.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

color-gray-950.label: Gray 950
color-gray-950.note: Colors that default to a gray shade follow it.

form-stroke.label: Field border
form-stroke.note: Border of inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios.

form-color.label: Field text
form-color.note: Text typed in inputs and selects.

form-active-color.label: Field focus and checked
form-active-color.note: Focus outline and checked checkboxes and radios.

form-error-color.label: Field error
form-error-color.note: Border of a field with an invalid value.

form-py.label: Field padding top and bottom
form-py.note: Inner space above and below the text of inputs and selects.

form-px.label: Field padding left and right
form-px.note: Inner space before and after the text of inputs and selects.

form-radius.label: Field corner radius
form-radius.note: Corner radius of inputs, selects and textareas. 0 gives square corners.
